Exercise normal precaution

in **Guadeloupe.**

Guadeloupe is generally a safe destination for travelers.

  * Guadeloupe regularly experiences hurricanes. Review our information on [Weather and Natural Disasters](/en/international-travel/travel-advisories/guadeloupe.html#weather "Weather and Natural Disasters in Guadeloupe") in Guadeloupe. 
  * Review our [Travel Guidance for Guadeloupe](/en/international-travel/travel-advisories/guadeloupe.html#requirements "Travel Guidance for Guadeloupe") to learn how to prepare for a safe trip.
